relevance.rationale: WRONG JOIN — REPORT LOUDLY. This row was seeded to 'faddeev_kashaev1994', whose registered entry is a mid-1990s physics-letters article on the quantum dilogarithm. The attached file is nothing of the kind: its front matter identifies it as a single-author math.GT arXiv preprint, id 1102.3530v1, on extracting the Chern-Simons invariant and the twisted Reidemeister torsion of the figure-eight knot from colored-Jones asymptotics. A 2010s arXiv preprint cannot be the 1990s article the id names. I searched folio/schema/references.ts for a matching id by preprint number, by author surname and by subject: none exists — the nearest same-surname entries (murakami2004, murakami-murakami2001) are demonstrably different works. So id is set to null and the document is an orphan needing its own ref() entry. RELEVANCE IS HIGH: it extracts BOTH the Chern-Simons invariant AND the twisted Reidemeister torsion of the figure-eight knot from the asymptotic behaviour of an evaluation of its colored Jones polynomial. The figure-eight knot is QOU's CAL-2 muon anchor (Vol(4_1)), and the corpus already carries blocks on the complex volume Vol + i*CS, on the 1-loop torsion, and on colored-Jones asymptotics — this is precisely that object, for precisely the knot the framework anchors on.

keyResults.statement: From the asymptotic behaviour of an evaluation of the colored Jones polynomial of the figure-eight knot one can extract both the Chern-Simons invariant and the twisted Reidemeister torsion associated with an SL(2,C) representation of the knot-group.
keyResults.useForFolio: Supplies, for the exact knot QOU anchors on, the joint colored-Jones to (CS, torsion) extraction that rem:complex-volume-character-variety-path and the 1-loop/torsion blocks currently treat as unsourced background.
